Roughly 70 searches a month name Essendon specifically, which is what earned Essendon a page. Add about 40 a month in Essendon searching for the glass, and you have the reason most Essendon bookings cover both.

Nothing published names Essendon in any way we can point at, and plenty of sites would write an Essendon job in anyway. Doing gutters in Essendon is the same work either way.

The signs

What you can see from the footpath

You can tell whether an Essendon gutter is overdue without a ladder. Wait for solid rain and stand on the footpath.

What you are looking for

Water coming over the front of the gutter rather than down the pipe. A downpipe that stays silent while the roof is running. A dark streak on the fascia or the wall below, which marks where it has been overflowing for years.

Any one of those means it is blocked now. A seedling growing out of it means it has been blocked for a very long time.

The roof above

What feeds the gutter

Clear the roof, not just the gutter

Material left on the tiles of an Essendon roof is back in the gutter after the next rain. Clearing the surface is part of the job rather than an extra.

Lichen is different from leaf

It roots into the tile rather than sitting on it, and it holds moisture against the surface. Washing knocks it off, treatment kills it.

Soft wash, never pressure

Pressure on roof tile strips the surface of the tile along with the growth. On a terracotta roof that is permanent.
